observed_sequence: Windows, Kenshi, Bayesian, swarm, and PC meta-optimizer branches
source_lineage.duplicate_note: DovoD5.py and DovoD5 (2).py are exact duplicates; the backup tree repeats the root sources.

evidence_value: The source and result files preserve a concrete progression of experiment designs rather than a retrospective narrative.
CSV and JSON meta logs agree row-for-row for all 542 root records.
Exact duplicate outputs are deduplicated and are not counted as independent replications.
limitations: Training datasets, environment dependencies, random-state capture, hardware configuration, and full replay transcripts are incomplete.
The results were not rerun and no external baseline was reproduced.
Producer score, entropy, mutual information, diversity, gap, and quantum terminology are retained as internal labels.
The all-zero mutual_info column in the 542-row meta log must not be interpreted as a validated information-theoretic result.
Raw CSV rows and executable experiment code are excluded from the meta registry.
